events_scope_check.name: events_scope_check
events_scope_check.value: "events"."organization_id" is not null or ("events"."type" = 'auth.login_failed' and "events"."actor" = 'system' and "events"."actor_id" is null and "events"."subject_operator_id" is null and "events"."case_id" is null and "events"."deleted_case_id" is null and "events"."case_reference" is null)

notifications_reminder_check.name: notifications_reminder_check
notifications_reminder_check.value:
"notifications"."kind" <> 'citizen_reminder' or
      ("notifications"."citizen_request_id" is not null and "notifications"."reminder_number" is not null
       and "notifications"."reminder_number" between 1 and 2 and "notifications"."case_id" is not null and "notifications"."organization_id" is not null)

quick_replies_text_check.name: quick_replies_text_check
quick_replies_text_check.value: length(trim("quick_replies"."title")) between 1 and 80 and length(trim("quick_replies"."text")) between 1 and 1000
